FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup Opens in Poland; Infantino Attendance Unconfirmed

The FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup has opened in Poland, with approximately 15,000 people expected for the initial matches. The tournament is scheduled to run until September 27. It is unclear whether FIFA President Gianni Infantino will attend the opening events.
